_: Per-key figure allow list for scripts/check-copy.mjs (landing v2, slice V2). A key (or a prefix ending in *) lists the substrings whose digits are attested; every other digit on the site is a FALLA. Add a row only with its source. Keys starting with `//` are the sources, read by humans.
//home.trayectoria.c3Valor: «+20 giros atendidos» — operator, 2026-09-03 (HQA-D77): twenty sectors attested in FDV §11.10, listed one by one. It was «+10», the conservative reading of the same inventory when fifteen were attested; E3c raised it to the figure the operator actually gave. The entry is keyed by MESSAGE KEY, not by locale, so it covers es.json and en.json at once — which is why a test asserts the two files agree on the value.
//home.aplicada.panel.kpis: Demonstration figures for the operation panel (E4, HQA-D91). They are INVENTED for the demo and the panel's chip says so on the panel itself, which is what source of truth §9/§10 requires of a mock: it must never present itself as a client screenshot. Listed ONE KEY AT A TIME rather than as a `kpis.*` prefix on purpose — a prefix would wave through every future digit under this subtree without anyone reading it, and the gate exists precisely so a new figure is a failure until somebody attests it. Each value is descriptive of VOLUME or STATE and never of benefit (guide §5.8): documents processed, quotes assembled, tasks in review, exceptions flagged. The deltas are period-over-period counts, not savings. NOTE: the weekly bar values live in components/home/PanelKPI.tsx and this list only reads messages/*.json, so the gate does not see them; what covers them is the demonstration chip, not this file.
